entries.answer:
Based on my research, here are the most advanced nontransformer model APIs available for your Replit integration:

 RWKV Language Model API

A nontransformer, RNNbased language model that processes text characterbycharacter and reviews documents completely. RWKV combines the advantages of RNNs with transformerlike parallelizable training.[1][2][3]

 Mamba (State Space Model)

Mamba is a selective structured state space model architecture that's completely attentionfree and designed for efficient longsequence processing. Unlike transformers which use attention mechanisms, Mamba uses state space models to process sequences linearly.[4][1]

 API Access Options

 RWKV API Services
 RWKV Runner: GUI with OpenAIcompatible API for PC[3][5]
 Ai00 Server: Fullfeatured inference API server with Vulkan support, compatible with most GPUs (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel)[2][6]
 OpenRouter: Provides API access to RWKV v5 World 3B model[7]

 Mamba API Services
 Codestral Mamba: Available through Mistral API or local installation[8]
 Various providers listed on LLM API comparison sites[9]

 Key Advantages for Document Processing

The RWKV model is particularly suitable for your use case because:[6][2]
 Processes all characters sequentially without truncation
 Uses linear time complexity (O(n)) instead of quadratic like transformers
 Supports long context windows (4K128K tokens)
 Available with quantization (INT8/NF4) for efficient deployment
 OpenAIcompatible API format for easy integration
